invariants.rationale: The factory method returns a new instance, so the result should never be null.
conf is a required parameter for constructing the metadata writer, so it cannot be null at method exit.
writeConfig is a required parameter for construction and must not be null.
context is passed directly to the constructor; it must be non-null.
The result of this method is always a JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter as per method implementation.
